sources: https://imperialbonitaestates.com/make-a-reservation/ (Newbook booking form, 23-ft rig, 1 night from 2026-11-10 and 2027-01-12, read in a browser)

values.note: Online daily rates (Newbook, 1 night): back-in $59 in October 2026 (read 2026-10-10), $72 on 2026-11-10 and $88 on 2027-01-12; pull-thru $87 and river $97 in November; premium $113 in November, $135 in January. The 2026-27 rate sheet (effective June 1, 2026) lists daily back-in $65 May-Oct, $80 Nov/Dec/Apr, $98 Jan-Mar, up to $135 for premium, about 10% above the online prices for every type but premium. Rates include water and sewer; a one-time electric activation fee per reservation; 3% charge for paying by card.

values.note: Booked on the resort's own Newbook form, or by phone at (239) 992-0511 when the form shows no availability. Stays of 28 days or less are paid in full at booking; in season (Nov-Apr) no refund for cancelling under 28 days out. Specific site numbers are not guaranteed for stays under three months.

note: AGE-RESTRICTED: 55+ (at least one occupant 55 or older, the second 45 or older). Resident-owned co-op off Bonita Beach Rd by the Imperial River, with river access for kayaks, that rents RV lots nightly. --Claude
summary: Operator's site, 2026-27 rate sheet and Newbook form: changed fees high $87 -> $135 (January premium; low $59 kept), good_sam false -> true (operator's 10% Good Sam/AAA/military daily discount). Added 50-amp full hookups, showers/laundry/Wi-Fi/dump, operator booking. Confirmed pull-throughs and military discount. Note cleaned of the prices the fees carry. No minimum stay or rig-length limit posted.
flags: Long-stay tests: a 55+ resident-owned co-op ('occupancy by households of which at least one person is fifty-five (55) years of age, and the second occupant must be at least forty-five (45)', RV Resort Area Rules 2026), with homes sold by owners in the co-op section. Nightly rates are posted and bookable online with no minimum, so it passes the nights-for-sale test; AWH's Fort Myers exception covers the price.
good_sam changed from the Good Sam directory's derived false to true on the operator's own statement of a 10% Good Sam discount (not a Good Sam Park designation).
